item: R844 (row 449): link density is a corroborating signal only and can never disqualify a source alone
summary: The field analysis (#2418) found link_density_rate alone disqualifying about 100 mainstream outlets per re-checking instance: an extraction-failure criterion with no floor, read by derive_status as degraded, which decide_verdict maps to disqualified. The criterion is now marked corroborates_only: derive_status reads the signature by criterion name without it, so alone or with soft signals only it is watch (qualified), and beside the pathology signature it still makes a source failing. Its evidence guard and flag record are unchanged; a stored failing list from before is judged by the new rule. The sources panel marks it 'corroborates only' with a hover (2 keys x12) and no longer as able to disqualify. CRITERIA_VERSION moves to oo-source-qualification-4, a label only: nothing re-judges on it, so the sources it disqualified come back at their normal re-check cadence. No stage bump, no re-extraction, no schema change.
